snippet.title: Chonky Cat Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4047670/Chonky_Cat/

Become the fluffiest menace in Chonky Cat, play as a massively overfed cat on a never ending binge. Chase, crush, and devour waves of creatures to grow even fatter and more unstoppable. Eat everything, unlock upgrades, multipliers and customizations and see just how big your belly can get!
